subcommands.name: create-firewall-rule
subcommands.description: Creates a single DNS Firewall rule in the specified rule group, using the specified domain list

options.description: A unique string that identifies the request and that allows you to retry failed requests without the risk of running the operation twice.

options.name: --priority
options.description: The setting that determines the processing order of the rule in the rule group.

options.name: --action
options.description: The action that DNS Firewall should take on a DNS query when it matches one of the domains in the rule's domain list, or a threat in a DNS Firewall Advanced rule: ALLOW - Permit the request to go through.

options.name: --block-response
options.description: The way that you want DNS Firewall to block the request, used with the rule action setting BLOCK.

options.name: --block-override-domain

options.name: --block-override-dns-type
options.description: The DNS record's type.

options.name: --block-override-ttl
options.description: The recommended amount of time, in seconds, for the DNS resolver or web browser to cache the provided override record.

options.name: --name
options.description: A name that lets you identify the rule in the rule group

options.name: --firewall-domain-redirection-action
options.description: How you want the the rule to evaluate DNS redirection in the DNS redirection chain, such as CNAME or DNAME.

options.name: --qtype
options.description: The DNS query type you want the rule to evaluate.

options.name: --dns-threat-protection
options.description: Use to create a DNS Firewall Advanced rule

options.name: --confidence-threshold
options.description: The confidence threshold for DNS Firewall Advanced.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
